{{Quote|I'm no leader. I just pay attention. I know things. Like the fact that the Rebel Alliance is our greatest hope. If we want to stop another Alderaan.|Kiro Chen to Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
'''Kiro Chen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] with the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], making Chen and thousands of Alderaanians refugees to [[Delaya]], Alderaan's sister planet. Chen became a leader of one of the many Alderaanian survivor groups and at some point formed an [[Alderaanian faction]] with his lover [[Halle Dray]], and fellow refugee [[J'er Nahj]]. The faction was strongly opposed against the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa Family]], blaming them for entangling Alderaan into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] and causing its destruction.

With his work with the survivor groups, Chen eventually came into contact with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Acting as a representative, Chen hinted that his group was planning to join the Alliance and for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], was instrumental in helping Rieekan draft survivors for the Rebels, earning the General's confidence. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Mission to Delaya|visited]] Delaya to lead a [[Memorial service on Delaya|memorial]] for Alderaan's lost. However, her true mission was to assist in the enlistment of new Alliance members. Rieekan introduced Chen to Organa as her local contact before leaving Delaya for a separate mission. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after attending the memorial, Chen arranged a meeting between the Princess and the survivor communities willing to join the Alliance.

The meeting turned out to be a ruse and Chen helped his faction in abducting Organa under the orders of Dray. They planned to turn her over to the Empire in exchange for a new planet for the refugees. During their meeting, the Imperials betrayed the faction leaders and killed them all, save for Chen, who was able to escape with Organa's help when she refused to reveal his location to the Imperials. After Organa was rescued by her Rebel companions, Chen met with her once again and she forgave his betrayal. Chen refused her offer to join the Alliance and decided to stay in Delaya and help lead the remaining survivors.

==Biography==
===Early years===
{{Quote|Leia, meet Kiro Chen. He's been an invaluable help to the cause these last few weeks.|Carlist Rieekan on Kiro Chen|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
[[File:Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alderaan, Chen's homeworld]]
Kiro Chen was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Hostage" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], sending Chen, and thousands of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees to Alderaan's sister planet [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. The refugees created communities in their new residence and Chen was recognized as a leader by some these groups. It was also during this time that Chen formed a [[Alderaanian faction|faction]] with [[Halle Dray]], his lover, and [[J'er Nahj]], another Alderanian refugee. Their faction despised the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organas]] for getting Alderaan involved in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]], and subsequently destroyed.<ref name="Hostage" />

Going undercover, Chen approached [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] as a representative of a group of Alderaanian survivors willing to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. For [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], Chen worked tirelessly in recruitment efforts and eventually earned Rieekan's trust. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Mission to Delaya|visited]] Delaya to help the refugees, Chen was introduced to her by Rieekan as someone who's been a great help to the Rebellion.<ref name="Hostage" />

===Betraying the Alliance===
{{Quote|With Nahj gone, and Halle...they need leaders.|Kiro Chen|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
[[File:LeiaOrgana-TSS.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Princess Leia Organa, who Chen's faction blamed for Alderaan's destruction]]
Chen was instrumental in abducting Organa before her meeting with the other representatives of various Alderaanian survivor groups that wanted to join the Rebel Alliance. Dray, one of the leaders of the faction, contacted the Empire and planned to turn Organa over to them in exchange for a new planet the Alderaanians could settle on. However, the Imperials reneged on the deal and took Organa after killing her abductors. Chen was the only one who survived when Organa did not divulged his hiding place to her new captors. Later on he informed Organa's companions, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Ferus Olin]], that Delaya's [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] [[Var Lyonn]] was secretly collaborating with the Imperials and knew where Organa was taken. After her rescue, Organa forgave Chen and invited him to join the Rebel Alliance; an offer Chen declined. He explained that with the recent deaths of Dray and [[J'er Nahj]], the Alderaanian survivors on Delaya would need a leader to look up to and he planned on filling in that role.<ref name="Hostage" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Everything's going to go as planned. Easy as skinning a nerf.|Kiro Chen|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
Kiro Chen had spiky [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and his eyes were hooded and red rimmed. He had a habit of using ''easy as skinning a nerf'' as a metaphor, which led to Luke Skywalker realizing that he was part of the Alderaniaan faction that abducted him previously.

==Behind the scenes==
Kiro Chen was a character created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]'', the second volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Hostage" />
